{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the correct string value for test orders
print("Unique revenue strings:", df['revenue'].unique())

# Now filter: only completed orders, exclude test orders (revenue == '999,999.99')
test_orders_mask = df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'

# Apply both filters
filtered_df = df[completed_mask & ~test_orders_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_float'].sum()

# Output
print("Number of test orders found:", test_orders_mask.sum())
print("Number of completed orders (before filtering):", completed_mask.sum())
print("Number of completed orders (after filtering):", len(filtered_df))
print("Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders):", total_revenue)"}
